prompt:
Photorealistic wide establishing photograph, 16:9 widescreen.
Subject: an empty, calm subway station concourse in Seoul-style design in the late afternoon: a row of modern ticket gates, a ticket machine on the side wall, a few distant blurred commuters walking far in the background.
Setting: clean tiled floor, white and light-grey walls, a staircase leading up toward daylight at the far end. Every sign, screen and map is softly blurred and unreadable.
Lighting: soft natural daylight from the stairway mixed with even overhead station light, gentle and quiet mood.
Shot: eye-level, 28mm lens, deep but slightly soft background, plenty of calm empty floor space in the lower half for on-screen captions.
Text: absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no Hangul, no readable signage anywhere.
No watermark, no AI logos, no Gemini logo or sparkle icons, clean corners without stamps or overlays, ultra-clean edges.
